title: Twelve recipes with more weight
body: I felt the recipes looked a bit pale. You could tell one from another side by side, but few of them read as film at a glance, so I went looking for why.

The numbers were plain once counted. Of the 53 recipes, 39 pulled the highlights down and 38 shot at DR200 or DR400, both of which flatten a picture. Colour at its highest setting added less than a fifth. And not one recipe used the two tools made for exactly this, HSL and Curves.

So twelve new recipes are built the other way round. Each stands on a film already in the app, shoots at DR100, and carries a tone curve of its own with a toe and a shoulder, so blacks are black and the brightest parts roll off instead of clipping. All but the black and white one also use HSL to deepen greens and skies.

body: Stronger colour found a problem straight away. On test portraits the five warm recipes sent faces orange. Those five now keep most of the film's colour off a face and ease the orange band, so the room goes warm and the person in it does not.

Seven of the twelve are free and five come with the unlock, which makes 65 recipes, 50 of them free. Four films that had no recipe at all have their first one: Pollen Neg, Toffee Neg, Lantern Neg and Ink Neg.
